_comment: Issue #208 — settings-as-code mirror of the live GitHub ruleset that protects the default branch (Develop). Two hardening changes over the previously-live config: `require_code_owner_review` is now true so the .github/CODEOWNERS rules on privileged paths (.github/workflows/, .github/actions/, .github/rulesets/) are enforced at merge, and a `non_fast_forward` rule blocks force-pushes to the protected branch. The required 1-approval review and required status checks were already live and are retained. Keep this file in sync with the live ruleset; edits here are NOT auto-applied — a repo admin must PUT this payload to /repos/stSoftwareAU/NEAT-AI-core/rulesets/15236989 (GET the current ruleset first to confirm the id). Required signed commits is deliberately NOT enabled — the `Auto-format Code` / `Auto-increment Versions` CI jobs push unsigned commits with the ACTIONS_PUSH PAT and a signed-commit rule would reject them.
